mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library with the moon in the first quarter. You can catch the International Space Station flying high in the sky tonight from the direction of Mount Horeb toward Madison starting at 5:44 PM. The overnight low will hit 30 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Plan Commission has released the agenda for their December 7th meeting, featuring a site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the City has issued official notices regarding the upcoming general and spring elections.

There is plenty to do in town. We have live music at Bailey's Run today and at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Tomorrow also brings yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a full schedule of trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's starting Tuesday.

Looking at the weekly report, officers responded to an incident on October 25th at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a man for an O W I offence after he was found stopped at the intersection for quite some time.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Mint Explosion. We are currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat before we wrap up for the evening.
